Class PlayerBecomeKingEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.despical.kotl.api.events.KOTLEvent
dev.despical.kotl.api.events.player.PlayerEvent
dev.despical.kotl.api.events.player.PlayerBecomeKingEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public class PlayerBecomeKingEvent extends PlayerEvent implements org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
Called immediately before a player becomes king in a KOTL arena.

The player has already passed the built-in repeated-king and cooldown checks when this event is fired. Cancelling it prevents the crown change, cooldown, score updates, announcements, fireworks, and plate knockback.

The previous king name may be null when the arena has not yet had a king during the current runtime. A repeated claim means the same player is claiming the plate again while consecutive king claims are enabled.

Since:
2.8.1
